decisions.reason: The existing message-146 FAQ MODIFY already reflects the founder's share net of fiat fees, the $5 referral commission, and the no-referral allocation; no additional change is required.
Deducting applicable fiat fees from the founder's revenue share does not change the Transak provider, conversion flow, or supported payment methods.
The code-used referral commission remains an immediate $5 wallet payout; the revenue-allocation update does not alter this candidate's current behavior.
The candidate's message-146 INTRODUCE already records the $5 commission going to a random existing NFT holder when no referral code is used.
The founder-share and commission-accounting update does not change referral ticket quantities, recipients, issuance triggers, or ticket cycles.
The source restates the existing random-holder ticket allocation when no referral code is entered and does not change its current state.
Revenue allocation and fiat-fee treatment do not alter which NFT-linked entitlements, badges, referral identity, or tickets transfer on resale.
The revenue-allocation update does not change the mint-number referral identity, its lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The source decision does not change the metadata counters, permanent badges, or mint-number referral attribute.
The source preserves Big Block funding and does not change its prize amount, winner count, draw interval, eligible tickets, or counted sale types.
Founder-share and commission accounting do not affect Chainlink VRF, ticket weighting, eligible holders, or on-chain verification.
The source preserves Small Block funding and does not change its prizes, draw interval, counted sales, eligible-ticket window, or post-draw reset.
